fields.label: Standard Line Name
fields.description: e.g. 'Trade Receivables', 'Cost of Sales', 'Deferred Tax Liability'

fields.label: Classification
fields.description: Drives the IAS 1 current/non-current mechanical check in the Rule Flag engine.

fields.label: Audit Head (Assignment Grouping)
fields.description: Groups this FS line into an assignable audit work area (e.g. multiple GL accounts under 'Trade Receivables', 'Bad Debt Provision' etc. all roll into the 'Loans & Advances - Non-Performing' Audit Head). Drives the auto-suggested task list in the Assignment Manager — see assignment_manager.py.

fields.label: Default Note Reference / Disclosure Trigger
fields.description: Which Compliance Checklist Item(s) this line typically triggers, e.g. related party balances -> IAS 24 checklist.
